comment: Downloads the title script starts while the engine starts up (src/main.js, core/Prefetch.js; pillar 1): when the `scriptCount` engine scripts matching `scripts` (capture: chunk name) have arrived, or when the engine module resolves. `assets`: manifest keys nearly every start needs (both slice regions use the kampung kit; the wisp is in both). The player's model: `prologueAvatar` for a new save or ?mission=<prologueMission>, else `avatar`. `transcoder`: Basis files warmed into the HTTP cache. `saveKey` must match SaveManager's key. `dataFiles`: prefixes of the on-demand data files requested at once (missions, dialogue, region layouts).
